checked_claims.note: FAILED on its second half. The first half (purely type-(ii) carrying bases exist, e.g. S=Spec k with the FND-0154 object) is correct and answers the theorem's 'can a connected component be purely type (ii)' clause in its literal reading. The second half -- 'every type-(ii) point of the ambient fixed-target balanced Hurwitz scheme lies on a component meeting type (i)' -- is proved by an argument whose two central steps are false and vacuous respectively. Step 1: 'A general B avoids the four ramification points of q and contains no pair exchanged by the q-involution; then gamma has eighteen distinct simple branch values.' This is false. With gamma = q o psi and B disjoint from Ram(q) and from its own q-involute, the branch locus of gamma has exactly FOURTEEN points: over each of the 10 points q(b), b in B, the fibre is 2+1+1 (a transposition), and over each of the 4 branch values of q the fibre is (2,2) (two points of ramification index 2, a double transposition, since psi is etale over the q-ramification point). Total ramification 10*1 + 4*2 = 18 = 2g-2 - d(2*0-2), so Riemann-Hurwitz is satisfied with 14 branch values, not 18 simple ones. Step 1 is not merely generically false: NO composed degree-four cover is simply branched, because a simply branched connected degree-four cover has monodromy generated by transpositions and transitive, hence S_4, which is primitive on four letters, whereas a factoring cover has imprimitive monodromy inside a conjugate of S_2 wr S_2. Step 2: 'Every type-(ii) point is connected inside the reduced-divisor parameter space to such a simply branched point' is therefore vacuous -- every point of that parameter space is type (ii), hence non-simply-branched, so the set of 'such simply branched points' is empty. Consequently the smoothness/dimension-18 input ('etale over the configuration space of eighteen branch values') is never established at any type-(ii) point, and the comparison 'dim <= 14 < 18' has no local dimension statement to compare against. The asserted conclusion appears to be TRUE, but by a different argument (see finding candidate FC-REV0156-HURWITZ-Nsheaf-SMOOTH), so this is incomplete rather than refuted. Independent corroboration of the branch-profile computation was obtained from a read-only worker check.

Reduction-to-dependency claim; content matches the packet-adjudicated FND-0141 (S-smooth of pure relative dimension two, codimension-four regular immersion), FND-0142/FND-0139 (h^0(D)=2, h^0(L)=3, h^1(L)=2 with the k=4 jump stratum empty under (BAL)), and FND-0134 (nonempty dense distinct-support open). Grauert is applied only over the reduced base as FND-0131 requires. The 'harmless ambiguity of tensoring L by a line bundle from S' is legitimate: it does not change P_S(pi_*L), and FND-0157 records the exactness of 0 -> Pic(T) -> Pic(C_T) -> Pic_{C/S}(T) that makes the Abel-Jacobi section canonical. Attacked and not broken: I checked the stated cross-check that reduction is applied to both sides of the ordering map (FND-0087) and that base is a scheme, not a stack, so FND-0127/FND-0144 stack-widening is not invoked.

Verified independently. Ranks are right: dim Sym^3 H^0(L) = 10, h^0(L^3) = 18-6+1 = 13 with h^1 = 0 since deg L^3 = 18 > 2g-2 = 10. ker(nu_s) is the space of plane cubics vanishing on the image of phi_L: zero for an integral sextic (Bezout), one-dimensional for a smooth cubic image, matching FND-0153's exhaustive dichotomy, so rank is 10 or 9 and never lower. On the reduced S_ii, rank-9 at every point gives I_9 = O by Nakayama and I_10 = 0 by reducedness, hence K = ker(nu) is a line subbundle and the quotient is a subbundle; this is the constant-rank route the attempt advertises, and it does avoid the uncontrolled scheme-theoretic image. Relative Cartier + fibrewise-smooth-cubic gives Y -> S_ii smooth; C -> P factors through V(cubic) scheme-theoretically because the cubic dies in pi_*(L^3); proper + fibrewise finite gives finite; the fibral flatness criterion (C and Y both S_ii-flat, fibres finite flat of degree 2) gives psi finite locally free of rank two. Trace splitting needs 2 invertible, which holds in characteristic zero. iota-stability of D_U is legitimate because on a type-(ii) fibre H^0(L) = psi^*H^0(N) exactly (h^0(N)=3 and h^0(N ⊗ M^{-1}) = 0 since deg = -2), so every member of |L| is a pullback; two relative effective Cartier divisors agreeing on all fibres of a flat family coincide. Freeness of iota on D_U over the reduced-support open is correct: a fixed point would be a ramification point of psi, forcing a non-reduced member.

Conclusion correct; it reproves the already-adjudicated FND-0155 on its type-(i) scope, and the 'primitive + transposition => S_6' step is proved directly rather than by citing Jordan, which is a legitimate variant (transitivity forces every letter into the support of the conjugacy class, so all components of the transposition graph have size >= 2 and disconnectedness would give a nontrivial block system). One presentational slip that I checked does not break the conclusion: 'A pair in the remaining irreducible open determines one line, and restriction over U_s gives an irreducible finite etale cover of degree 30' conflates two different schemes. The ordered-pair incidence I_2 = {(l,(p,q)) : p != q in phi_L^*l} IS finite etale of degree 30 over all of |L|^{rs}, but it is NOT an open subscheme of (C x C) minus diagonal minus Sigma: over a line through a node of X_L the pair of branch preimages lies in Sigma while the line is not determined by the pair, so I_2 -> C x C has one-dimensional fibres there. The repair is one line -- the locus of I_2 lying over Sigma is one-dimensional, every component of the smooth surface I_2|_{U_s} is two-dimensional, hence the irreducible open piece isomorphic to an open of C x C is dense and I_2|_{U_s} is irreducible -- and FND-0155 already states the careful form ('dominant of generic degree 30'). Also noted and harmless: for a cuspidal X_L the pencil of lines through a cusp is an extra discriminant component not contained in X_L^vee, which does not affect an argument that only needs a general tangent line.

This is the artifact's principal novel content -- it closes the exact-image obligation FND-0155 explicitly leaves open in type (ii) -- and it survives the strongest attack I could mount. Containment G <= W is forced by the global 3-pair partition. The discriminant is exactly Y^vee union the ten lines Delta_b, b in B (a member psi^*(l cap Y) is non-reduced iff l is tangent to Y or l meets B), and Delta_b is not a component of the irreducible degree-six Y^vee, so a general point of Delta_b is a legitimate simple-degeneration point. Kummer inertia there is a within-block transposition because psi is simply ramified at b and the moving intersection point is a uniformizer on a transverse trait. The degree-three block cover is the restriction of the P^1-bundle over the irreducible Y, hence irreducible, giving transitivity in S_3; a general nonflex tangent to Y away from B swaps two blocks, giving a transposition in S_3, so the image in S_3 is all of S_3. Conjugating one within-block transposition by lifts of a transitive S_3-image produces all three, and those generate the kernel (S_2)^3; with surjectivity onto S_3 and containment in W this forces G = W of order 48. I found no gap. Deg B = 10 and B nonempty are forced by the genus (an etale double cover of an elliptic curve has genus one, not six), so the transposition source is never empty.

Connectedness of U_alpha from connectedness of S_alpha is correct (an open surjection with connected fibres cannot separate the base). The type-(i) direction is functoriality of pi_1^et along U_b -> U_alpha, exactly as in FND-0155. The purely type-(ii) direction correctly needs BOTH inclusions with respect to the SAME trivialization: the global block system from Section 1 gives H_alpha <= W for the specific W stabilizing that partition, and CLM-0111-4 gives H_alpha >= W for the same one, so no hidden conjugation ambiguity. 'There are no intermediate monodromy images' is a consequence of the exhaustive dichotomy, not an independent assertion.

Confirmed, and this is a real advance over the normality restriction that FND-0132/FND-0144/FND-0148 impose on the [S_6:H] component formula: the attempt does NOT need U_beta normal. The reason (compressed in the text but valid) is that the count is taken at the generic point. K_beta = K(U_beta) = K(U_eta), where U_eta is the generic fibre over the generic point eta of S_beta; U_eta is an open subscheme of P^2_{kappa(eta)}, hence normal and integral, so Gal(K_beta) surjects onto pi_1^et(U_eta) and the field-factor count of the etale S_6-algebra Z_{K_beta} is [S_6 : H_gen] for H_gen the image of Gal(K_beta). H_gen contains the geometric monodromy of U_{eta-bar}, which is S_6 (type (i)) or W (type (ii)) by CLM-0111-3/4 applied to the geometric generic fibre, an honest geometric fibre over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field; and in the type-(ii) case H_gen <= W because the block system of Section 1 is defined over S_ii hence over kappa(eta). Every irreducible component of the finite etale Z|_{U_beta} dominates U_beta by dimension, so field factors and irreducible components correspond exactly. I also verified the bookkeeping downstream: the U_beta are exactly the irreducible components of U, Irr(Z) is their disjoint union, right multiplication by S_6 permutes the fifteen connected components transitively and forces the uniform distribution b_alpha per component, and the a_alpha > 0 case is consistently connected-but-reducible with a_alpha + 15 b_alpha irreducible components. The relative-dimension-two and dim(S_beta)+2 clauses are correctly conditionalized on local finite type. Deduction: the attempt should state the generic-fibre step explicitly rather than writing only 'the generic monodromy is S_6', since a reader will otherwise read it as the very normality-dependent step FND-0132 blocks.

The coset conventions comply with FND-0151: components indexed by the orbit set H\S_6 of left multiplication (right cosets Hg), right deck action Hg.a = Hga, stabilizer g^{-1}Hg, not gHg^{-1}. The centralizer computation is correct: S_6 with H acting by left multiplication is fifteen copies of the regular H-set, whose H-equivariant automorphism group is H^op wr S_15 (order 48^15 * 15!), and for H = S_6 the cover is connected Galois with Aut = S_6^op = S_6. The distinction between the canonical right S_6 and the full Aut_U(Z) is drawn correctly and is exactly the kind of over-claim the campaign has been guarding against.

The pencil recovery is sound and is the correct answer to the FND-0137 trap. On Z one has O_C(Gamma) = L = omega_C(-D), hence O_C(D) = omega_C(-Gamma) with h^0 = 2 (CLM-0088/FND-0142), so gamma = phi_{|omega_C(-Gamma)|} is reconstructed from (C,Gamma) alone; an automorphism fixing the six labelled points therefore automatically preserves the pencil and induces a unique target automorphism, and injectivity of Aut^mov -> Aut(C;x_i) holds because gamma is surjective. This is the FND-0147 mechanism, and it is what makes FND-0137's warning inapplicable here rather than merely unaddressed. 'Scheme inertia is trivial' is tautological over a scheme base and the artifact says so; combined with the explicit exclusion of stack bases in theorem_scope, no stack-versus-coarse-moduli upgrade is smuggled in. The bielliptic-involution clause is correct: iota acts by post-composition, hence as left multiplication by the central element (12)(34)(56) of W after a block-compatible trivialization; it therefore preserves each right coset Wg, and it is not a global right translation because left multiplication by c equals right multiplication by a fixed a only if c is central in S_6, which it is not.

finding_candidates.statement: Let k be algebraically closed of characteristic zero. (a) No connected degree-four cover gamma : C -> P^1 that factors nontrivially through an intermediate curve is simply branched. A simply branched connected degree-four cover has monodromy that is transitive and generated by transpositions, hence S_4, which is primitive on four letters; a factorization C -> Y -> P^1 induces a block system and imprimitive monodromy inside a conjugate of S_2 wr S_2. (b) Quantitatively, for the FND-0154 balanced type-(ii) family (Y elliptic, q = phi_{|P|} of degree two with four branch points, psi : C -> Y the double cover branched along a reduced B in |M^{tensor 2}| of degree ten, gamma = q o psi), with B disjoint from Ram(q) and satisfying sigma(B) cap B = empty for the q-involution sigma, the branch locus of gamma consists of exactly FOURTEEN points of P^1: ten with fibre type 2+1+1 (local monodromy a transposition, over q(b) for b in B) and four with fibre type (2,2) (local monodromy a double transposition, over the branch values of q, because psi is etale above the q-ramification point so both of its preimages acquire index two). The total ramification 10*1 + 4*2 = 18 agrees with Riemann-Hurwitz 2*6-2 = 4*(2*0-2) + deg R. If B meets Ram(q) the corresponding fibre becomes a 4-cycle; if B contains a sigma-pair two transposition fibres merge into an extra (2,2).

finding_candidates.consequence: Combined with the fourteen-dimensional parameter count for balanced type-(ii) covers (four branch points for q, one for M in Pic^5(Y), nine for B in |M^{tensor 2}| = P^9) and with openness of balancedness (h^0(F(-6)) = 0 is an open condition by semicontinuity), this yields the intended conclusion honestly: every irreducible component of the balanced fixed-target Hurwitz scheme through a type-(ii) point has local dimension 18 > 14, hence is not contained in the type-(ii) locus, hence meets type (i). A future attempt should route CLM-0111-9's second half through this normal-sheaf input, and should additionally prove (rather than assert) that the composed locus is closed.

finding_candidates.statement: The repair for the step broken by FC-REV0156-COMPOSED-NEVER-SIMPLY-BRANCHED does not need simple branching at all. For a finite morphism gamma : C -> P^1 of degree d from a smooth projective curve of genus g over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, with the target held fixed, the map T_C -> gamma^*T_{P^1} of line bundles is injective, so the Hurwitz normal sheaf N_gamma = coker(T_C -> gamma^*T_{P^1}) is TORSION, supported on the ramification divisor, of length deg(gamma^*T_{P^1}) - deg(T_C) = 2d + 2g - 2, independently of the ramification profile. A torsion sheaf on a curve has vanishing H^1, so H^1(N_gamma) = 0 for EVERY such gamma, the fixed-target Hurwitz deformation functor is unobstructed with tangent space H^0(N_gamma), and the fixed-target Hurwitz stack of degree-d genus-g covers is smooth of dimension 2d + 2g - 2 at every point, whatever the branching. For (d,g) = (4,6) this dimension is 18.

finding_candidates.statement: The normality hypothesis that FND-0132, FND-0144 and FND-0148 attach to the '[S_6:H] irreducible components of degree |H|' formula can be removed on the C66-GEO-COMP model, over a base S that is reduced and locally Noetherian but possibly non-normal and reducible, by counting at the generic point of each irreducible component rather than on the whole base. Concretely: let S_beta be an irreducible component of S with its reduced structure, eta its generic point, U_beta = U x_S S_beta and U_eta the generic fibre. Because U -> S is smooth with fibres open in P^2, U_beta is integral and U_eta is an OPEN SUBSCHEME OF P^2_{kappa(eta)}, hence normal and integral, with K(U_beta) = K(U_eta). Therefore Gal(K(U_beta)) surjects onto pi_1^et(U_eta), the number of field factors of the etale S_6-algebra Z_{K(U_beta)} equals [S_6 : H_gen] for H_gen the image of Gal(K(U_beta)) in S_6, and every irreducible component of the finite etale Z|_{U_beta} dominates U_beta (finite morphism, equidimensional of dim U_beta), so field factors correspond exactly to irreducible components. H_gen is then squeezed between the geometric monodromy of the geometric generic fibre U_{eta-bar} (computable by the single-fibre theorems, since kappa(eta)-bar is algebraically closed of characteristic zero) and any globally defined structure the family carries over S_beta.

finding_candidates.statement: On a balanced type-(ii) geometric fibre over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero (hypotheses (CE)+(N)+(BAL) at (g,n) = (6,6), with psi : C -> Y the bielliptic double cover of the smooth plane cubic Y, reduced branch divisor B of degree ten, N = O_{P^2}(1)|_Y and L = psi^*N), the geometric monodromy image of pi_1^et(|L|^{rs}) -> S_6 is EXACTLY the wreath product W = S_2 wr S_3 of order 48, not merely contained in it. The proof is: (1) H^0(L) = psi^*H^0(N) exactly, since h^0(N) = 3 and h^0(N tensor M^{-1}) = 0 (degree -2), so |L| is the dual plane and the three fibres of psi over a line section give a global 2+2+2 block system, whence G <= W; (2) the discriminant is Y^vee union the ten lines Delta_b (b in B), Delta_b is not a component of the irreducible degree-six Y^vee, and Kummer inertia at a general point of Delta_b -- where the moving intersection point of the line with Y is a uniformizer on a transverse trait and psi is simply ramified at b -- is a within-block transposition; (3) the degree-three block cover is the restriction of the P^1-bundle over the irreducible Y, hence irreducible, giving transitivity in S_3, and a general nonflex tangent to Y away from B swaps two blocks, giving a transposition, so the image in S_3 is all of S_3; (4) conjugating the within-block transposition by lifts of the transitive S_3-image gives all three within-block transpositions, which generate the kernel (S_2)^3, and together with surjectivity onto S_3 and containment in W this forces G = W.

strongest_attack: STRONGEST ATTACK THAT SUCCEEDED (Section 8, second paragraph; CLM-0111-9). The attempt's ambient-Hurwitz clause rests on the assertion that a general member of the FND-0154 type-(ii) family has 'eighteen distinct simple branch values', so that the fixed-target Hurwitz scheme is etale over Conf_18 and smooth of dimension 18 at that point, whence the fourteen-dimensional type-(ii) locus cannot be a component. That branch count is wrong, and wrong structurally rather than generically. For gamma = q o psi with B disjoint from Ram(q) and from its q-involute, the branch locus is FOURTEEN points: ten of type 2+1+1 (transpositions, over q(b) for b in B) and four of type (2,2) (double transpositions, over the branch values of q, where psi is etale above the q-ramification point so BOTH preimages acquire index two). Ramification degree 10*1 + 4*2 = 18 matches Riemann-Hurwitz with fourteen branch values, not eighteen. More decisively, NO non-primitive degree-four cover is ever simply branched: simple branching plus connectedness forces monodromy generated by transpositions and transitive, hence S_4, which is primitive on four letters, whereas any factorization C -> Y -> P^1 gives a block system and imprimitive monodromy inside a conjugate of S_2 wr S_2. Hence the follow-up step 'Every type-(ii) point is connected inside the reduced-divisor parameter space to such a simply branched point' is vacuous -- every point of that parameter space is composed, hence non-simply-branched -- and no local dimension or smoothness statement is ever established at any type-(ii) point of the balanced Hurwitz scheme. The dimension comparison 14 < 18 is left comparing a bound against nothing. I believe the asserted conclusion is nevertheless true, by the route recorded in FC-REV0156-HURWITZ-Nsheaf-SMOOTH, so this is a proof failure rather than a refutation of the statement; the claim is unproved as written and the verdict is incomplete. This is not a harmless flourish: the ambient clause is the substantive reading of the theorem's third question, since the literal reading is discharged trivially by S = Spec k. The attempt additionally asserts without proof that the composed locus is closed in the Hurwitz scheme. STRONGEST ATTACKS THAT FAILED. (1) Section 3's exact type-(ii) image. I attacked the discriminant decomposition (Delta = Y^vee union ten lines Delta_b), the claim that a general point of Delta_b avoids Y^vee, the Kummer inertia computation, the surjection onto S_3, and the conjugation step generating (S_2)^3; every step holds, and h^0(N)=3 with h^0(N tensor M^{-1})=0 really does identify |L| with the dual plane. G = W of order 48 is correct and genuinely closes the gap FND-0155 left open. (2) Section 6's component count over a possibly non-normal base, which FND-0132/FND-0144/FND-0148 flag as requiring normality. The attempt evades the trap legitimately by counting field factors of the generic fibre over the generic point of each irreducible component S_beta, where U_eta is an open in P^2_{kappa(eta)} and hence normal; the step is compressed but valid, and the classical nodal-cubic counterexample (connected etale cover with two irreducible components) does not apply. (3) Section 7's centralizer W^op wr S_15 and the FND-0151 left/right coset conventions -- both correct. (4) Section 7's Aut^mov reconstruction against the FND-0137 trap -- correct, because on Z the pencil is canonically recovered as |omega_C(-Gamma)|, which is precisely FND-0147. (5) The whole battery of Hodge-theoretic attacks in the review prompt (BM-versus-cohomological degree, Poincare twists, Gysin/Kunneth shifts, degeneration differentials, invariants versus coinvariants, semisimplification, predicted motives, pure-Tate-to-tautological upgrades, omitted stable pairs) is inapplicable: the artifact makes no cohomological assertion at all and CLM-0111-10 disclaims correctly, so there is nothing to upgrade. Minor, non-fatal: Section 2 calls the ordered-pair incidence 'an open of C x C', which fails over lines through nodes of the plane sextic, though the cover is still finite etale of degree 30 and still irreducible for a one-line reason.
theorem_statement: Over a reduced locally Noetherian base carrying a balanced Casnati-Ekedahl genus-six degree-four family satisfying (CE), (BAL), and (N), determine the irreducible components, dimensions, deck and component stabilizers, and finite-cover behavior of the ordered evaluation-failure locus Z. In particular: compute the exact geometric monodromy image H_alpha of the finite etale S_6-ordering cover on every balanced component, including purely type-(ii) components if they exist; decide whether a connected component of the balanced base can consist entirely of type-(ii) fibres; give the resulting component count and component-stabilizer formula; and identify the relevant Aut / inertia groups for the ordered model. This lemma does not resolve the campaign Hodge/Tate group RED-0001.
